def __init__(self, model_dir: Path, threads: int = 1, encoder: str = "", decoder: str = ""):
        """``encoder`` / ``decoder``: the export's file suffix ("" fp32, "_int8"…). With a
        ``decoder_with_past_model`` beside the decoder (9 Oct 2026, whisper-small), text is decoded
        one token per step on the cached keys/values instead of re-running the whole prefix."""
        import onnxruntime as ort

        opts = ort.SessionOptions()
        opts.intra_op_num_threads = threads
        cpu = ["CPUExecutionProvider"]
        d = model_dir / "onnx"
        self.encoder = ort.InferenceSession(str(d / f"encoder_model{encoder}.onnx"), opts, providers=cpu)
        self.decoder = ort.InferenceSession(str(d / f"decoder_model{decoder}.onnx"), opts, providers=cpu)
        past = d / f"decoder_with_past_model{decoder}.onnx"
        self.past = ort.InferenceSession(str(past), opts, providers=cpu) if past.exists() else None
        self.present = [o.name for o in self.decoder.get_outputs() if o.name.startswith("present.")]
        self.name = f"{model_dir.name} (encoder {encoder.strip('_') or 'fp32'}, decoder {decoder.strip('_') or 'fp32'})"
        gen = json.loads((model_dir / "generation_config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        langs = sorted(gen["lang_to_id"].items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])
        self.codes = [k.strip("<|>") for k, _ in langs]
        self.lang_ids = np.array([v for _, v in langs])
        added = json.loads((model_dir / "added_tokens.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.nospeech_id = added.get("<|nocaptions|>", added.get("<|nospeech|>"))
        self.transcribe_id = added.get("<|transcribe|>")
        self.notimestamps_id = added.get("<|notimestamps|>")
        vocab = model_dir / "vocab.json"
        self.pieces: dict[int, str] = {}
        if vocab.exists() and self.transcribe_id and self.notimestamps_id:
            self.pieces = {i: t for t, i in json.loads(vocab.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).items()}

name: detect
summary: {"nospeech": p, "langs": [[code, p], …] best first} for a 16 kHz clip.
signature_or_pseudo: def detect(self, wave: np.ndarray, top: int = 3) -> dict
code_excerpt:
def detect(self, wave: np.ndarray, top: int = 3) -> dict:
        """{"nospeech": p, "langs": [[code, p], …] best first} for a 16 kHz clip."""
        (h,) = self.encoder.run(None, {"input_features": features(wave)[None]})
        logits = self.decoder.run(["logits"], {"input_ids": np.array([[SOT]], dtype=np.int64),
                                               "encoder_hidden_states": h})[0][0, -1].astype(np.float64)
        z = np.exp(logits - logits.max())
        nospeech = float(z[self.nospeech_id] / z.sum())
        lz = logits[self.lang_ids]
        p = np.exp(lz - lz.max())
        p /= p.sum()
        order = np.argsort(-p)[:top]
        out = {"nospeech": round(nospeech, 4), "langs": [[self.codes[i], round(float(p[i]), 4)] for i in order]}
        if self.pieces and nospeech < MAX_NOSPEECH and p[order[0]] >= MIN_P:
            out.update(self.transcribe(h, int(self.lang_ids[order[0]])))
        return out

name: transcribe
summary: Greedy text for encoded audio ``h`` in language ``lang_id``: {"text", "logprob", "rep"}.
signature_or_pseudo: def transcribe(self, h: np.ndarray, lang_id: int) -> dict
code_excerpt:
def transcribe(self, h: np.ndarray, lang_id: int) -> dict:
        """Greedy text for encoded audio ``h`` in language ``lang_id``: {"text", "logprob", "rep"}."""
        prefix = [SOT, lang_id, self.transcribe_id, self.notimestamps_id]
        ids: list[int] = []
        logps: list[float] = []
        rep = False
        cache: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
        for step in range(MAX_TOKENS):
            if self.past is None:
                lg = self.decoder.run(["logits"], {"input_ids": np.array([prefix + ids], dtype=np.int64),
                                                   "encoder_hidden_states": h})[0][0, -1]
            elif step == 0:  # the prefix once; its keys/values (decoder and encoder) are kept
                out = self.decoder.run(["logits", *self.present], {"input_ids": np.array([prefix], dtype=np.int64),
                                                                   "encoder_hidden_states": h})
                lg = out[0][0, -1]
                cache = {n.replace("present.", "past_key_values."): v for n, v in zip(self.present, out[1:], strict=True)}
            else:
                out = self.past.run(None, {"input_ids": np.array([[ids[-1]]], dtype=np.int64), **cache})
                lg = out[0][0, -1]
                for o, v in zip(self.past.get_outputs()[1:], out[1:], strict=True):  # decoder keys/values grow
                    cache[o.name.replace("present.", "past_key_values.")] = v
            lg = lg.astype(np.float64)
            lg[EOT + 1:] = -np.inf  # special and timestamp tokens: never text
            m = lg.max()
            nxt = int(lg.argmax())
            logps.append(float(-np.log(np.exp(lg - m).sum())))  # log-softmax of the argmax
            if nxt == EOT:
                break
            ids.append(nxt)
            if looping(ids):
                rep = True
                break

def at(v: np.ndarray, cos: float, seed: int) -> np.ndarray:
    """A unit vector with exactly ``cos`` similarity to ``v``."""
    r = unit(seed)
    r = r - (r @ v) * v
    r /= np.linalg.norm(r)
    return cos * v + np.sqrt(1 - cos * cos) * r

code_excerpt:
def test_compaction_expires_one_off_rooms_and_caps_the_rest(tmp_path):
    import atlas as atlas_mod

    alice = unit(1)
    fake_gallery(tmp_path, {"alice": alice})
    a = Atlas(tmp_path / "atlas.db", tmp_path)
    # A one-off room, a two-room persona, a named one-off, all old.
    gone = a.add("chaturbate:oneoff", unit(50), 0.9, None).persona_id
    pair = a.add("chaturbate:twin1", unit(60), 0.9, None).persona_id
    assert a.add("camsoda:twin2", near(unit(60), 61, 0.3), 0.9, None).persona_id == pair
    kept = a.add("chaturbate:named", unit(70), 0.9, None).persona_id
    a.dataset_name_for_room("chaturbate:named", "named")
    # A busy verified room: many varied faces, all alice.
    for k in range(40):
        a.add("chaturbate:ali", at(alice, 0.60 + (0.1 if k == 7 else 0.0), 200 + k), 0.9, None)
    ali = a.room_persona("chaturbate:ali")
    best = a.db.execute("SELECT MAX(match) FROM sightings WHERE room = 'chaturbate:ali'").fetchone()[0]
    assert a.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings WHERE room = 'chaturbate:ali'").fetchone()[0] > atlas_mod.ROOM_KEEP

    out = a.compact(now=time.time() + (atlas_mod.EXPIRE_DAYS + 1) * 86400)
    assert out["expired_personas"] == 1
    assert gone not in a.p_label and pair in a.p_label and kept in a.p_label and ali in a.p_label
    n, top = a.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(match) FROM sightings WHERE room = 'chaturbate:ali'").fetchone()
    assert n == atlas_mod.ROOM_KEEP and top == best, "cap keeps the strongest evidence"
    assert a.p_n[ali] == atlas_mod.ROOM_KEEP
    # The rebuilt matrix still matches: a new look at the pair joins it.
    assert a.add("camsoda:twin3", near(unit(60), 62, 0.3), 0.9, None).persona_id == pair
    # And a reload agrees with the in-memory sums.
    b = Atlas(tmp_path / "atlas.db", tmp_path)
    assert b.p_n[ali] == atlas_mod.ROOM_KEEP and gone not in b.p_label

def test_backfill_rebuilds_todays_thin_identities_once(tmp_path):

    ing = _bare()
    ing.gallery, ing.root = tmp_path, tmp_path / "imports"
    ing.root.mkdir()

    db.executescript("""CREATE TABLE identities (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, status TEXT, created_at TEXT);
                        CREATE TABLE face_crops (identity_id INTEGER, embedding BLOB);""")
    for i, (name, when, crops, photos) in enumerate([("new", "2026-09-29T23:00:00Z", 6, 14),
                                                     ("old", "2026-09-23T10:00:00Z", 6, 30),
                                                     ("full", "2026-09-29T23:10:00Z", 12, 12)], 1):
        db.execute("INSERT INTO identities VALUES (?, ?, 'locked', ?)", (i, name, when))
        db.executemany("INSERT INTO face_crops VALUES (?, x'00')", [(i,)] * crops)
        (tmp_path / name).mkdir()
        for k in range(photos):
            (tmp_path / name / f"{name}_{k:03d}.jpg").write_bytes(bytes([k]))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    seen = []
    ing.reindex = lambda name: seen.append(name) or "matched on 11 crops"
    import threading
    ing.write_lock, ing.on_change = threading.Lock(), None
    ing._todo, ing._todo_at, ing._trickled = None, 0.0, 0
    assert ing.backfill_todo() == ["new"]
    assert ing.trickle(5) == 1 and seen == ["new"]  # one lock per identity, between batches

    rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
    X = np.stack([featurize(rng.normal(size=768), rng.normal(size=512) if i % 3 else None,
                            float(rng.uniform(0, 0.1)), float(rng.uniform(-90, -10))) for i in range(40)])
    live = X.std(0) > 1e-6

def test_down_is_held_then_restarted_and_told_once(monkeypatch):
    g, told, restarts = guard(monkeypatch)
    t = 1_000_000.0
    g.check_embed(t, alive=False)
    g.check_embed(t + EMBED_DOWN_S - 1, alive=False)
    assert restarts == [] and told == []
    g.check_embed(t + EMBED_DOWN_S, alive=False)
    assert restarts == [t + EMBED_DOWN_S] and len(told) == 1 and "restarting" in told[0]
    g.check_embed(t + EMBED_DOWN_S + 300, alive=False)  # still loading: no second restart within 15 min
    assert len(restarts) == 1
    g.check_embed(t + EMBED_DOWN_S + 1000, alive=False)  # 15 min on and still down: again, but no new message
    assert len(restarts) == 2 and len(told) == 1
    g.check_embed(t + EMBED_DOWN_S + 1100, alive=True)
    assert len(told) == 2 and "again" in told[1]
    g.check_embed(t + EMBED_DOWN_S + 1200, alive=True)
    assert len(told) == 2

def test_queued_merges_run_together_under_one_hold_of_the_lock(world):
    import threading as th

    from merge import MergeDesk

    m, g, atlas, _ = world
    holds = []

    class CountingLock:
        def __init__(self):
            self.inner = th.Lock()

        def __enter__(self):
            self.inner.acquire()
            holds.append(1)
            return self

        def __exit__(self, *exc):
            self.inner.release()

    m.lock = CountingLock()
    desk = MergeDesk(m, atlas)
    m.lock.inner.acquire()  # ingest holds the gallery: both merges queue behind it
    out = {}
    t1 = th.Thread(target=lambda: out.__setitem__("a", desk.merge("camila", "camila7")))
    t2 = th.Thread(target=lambda: out.__setitem__("b", _err(lambda: desk.merge("other", "nobody"))))
    t1.start()
    t2.start()
    import time
    time.sleep(0.3)
    m.lock.inner.release()

def pull(self) -> int:
        remote = (f":sftp,host={OVH_HOST},user={OVH_USER},key_file='{KEY_FILE}',"
                  f"known_hosts_file='',shell_type=unix:{self.remote}")
        before = sum(1 for _ in self.dest.rglob("*.jpg"))
        # Sub-folders (rooms: <identity>/<site>__<room>/) come along; empty ones stay on the VPS.
        r = subprocess.run([RCLONE, "move", remote, str(self.dest), "--include", "**.jpg",
                            "--transfers", "2", "--retries", "2", "--log-level", "NOTICE"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            log.warning("%s pull (exit %s): %s", self.what, r.returncode, (r.stderr or r.stdout).strip()[-300:])
            return 0
        return sum(1 for _ in self.dest.rglob("*.jpg")) - before

def __init__(self, conf_thresh: float = 0.25, threads: int = 1) -> None:
        import onnxruntime as ort
        from face_organizer.toy_detector import ToyDetector

        path = weights()
        if path is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"no toy detector weights under {ONNX_WEIGHTS.parent}")
        self.weights = path
        self.mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
        opts = ort.SessionOptions()
        opts.intra_op_num_threads = threads
        opts.inter_op_num_threads = 1
        # Not ToyDetector(...): its constructor opens a CUDA session first (~1.3 GB of VRAM).
        det = ToyDetector.__new__(ToyDetector)
        det.conf_thresh, det.device, det.weights_path, det.backend = conf_thresh, "cpu", path, "onnx"
        det.class_names = {0: "lush", 1: "wand"}
        det._model = ort.InferenceSession(str(path), opts, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])
        self.detector = det
        log.info("toy detector: %s (classes %s), CPU", path.name, self.detector.class_names)

def _largest_cluster(faces: list[Face]) -> list[Face]:
    if not faces:
        return []
    m = np.stack([f.emb for f in faces])
    sims = m @ m.T
    best = int(np.argmax((sims >= SAME).sum(axis=1)))
    return [f for f, ok in zip(faces, sims[best] >= SAME, strict=True) if ok]

def detect(faces: Any, im: Image.Image, min_score: float = 0.5, min_px: int = 24) -> list[tuple[np.ndarray, float, tuple]]:
    """[(unit embedding, score, (x1, y1, x2, y2) px)], biggest face first. The worker detects at
    320 px, so a small face in a wide photo is missed: then try the photo's middle at 2x."""
    def read(img: Image.Image, scale: float, dx: float, dy: float) -> list:
        out = []
        for f in faces.get(np.asarray(img)[:, :, ::-1].copy()):
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = (float(c) for c in f.bbox)
            if f.det_score < min_score or min(x2 - x1, y2 - y1) < min_px:
                continue
            box = (x1 / scale + dx, y1 / scale + dy, x2 / scale + dx, y2 / scale + dy)
            out.append((f.normed_embedding.astype(np.float32), float(f.det_score), box))
        return out

    found = read(im, 1.0, 0, 0)
    if not found and min(im.size) >= 400:
        w, h = im.size
        crop = im.crop((w // 4, h // 8, w - w // 4, h - h // 2 + h // 8))
        found = read(crop.resize((crop.width * 2, crop.height * 2), Image.BICUBIC), 2.0, w // 4, h // 8)
    found.sort(key=lambda f: -(f[2][2] - f[2][0]) * (f[2][3] - f[2][1]))
    return found[:MAX_FACES]

def gallery_top(atlas: Any, v: np.ndarray, k: int = 5) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Gallery identities this face looks like, scored as the Atlas scores a room
    (mean of each identity's 3 best crops), best first."""
    with atlas.lock:
        names, mat, owner = atlas.kfc_names, atlas.kfc_mat, atlas.kfc_owner
    if not names or not len(mat):
        return []
    s = mat @ v
    near = np.argsort(-s)[:200]
    cands: list[int] = []
    for i in near:
        o = int(owner[i])
        if s[i] < SHOW_GALLERY - 0.05 or len(cands) >= k * 2:
            break
        if o not in cands:
            cands.append(o)
    out = []
    for o in cands:
        mine = s[owner == o]
        out.append({"name": names[o], "score": round(float(np.mean(np.sort(mine)[-3:])), 3), "photos": int(len(mine))})
    out = [g for g in out if g["score"] >= SHOW_GALLERY]
    out.sort(key=lambda g: -g["score"])
    return out[:k]

def persona_top(atlas: Any, v: np.ndarray, k: int = 5) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Atlas personas (people seen on cam) this face looks like, by centroid."""
    with atlas.lock:
        n = len(atlas._rows)
        if not n:
            return []
        sims = (atlas._S[:n] @ v) / np.maximum(atlas._norm[:n], 1e-6)
        rows = list(atlas._rows)
        kfc = {pid: name for name, pid in atlas.p_kfc.items()}
        labels = dict(atlas.p_label)
    out = []
    for i in np.argsort(-sims)[:k]:
        if sims[i] < SHOW_PERSONA:
            break
        pid = rows[int(i)]
        out.append({"id": pid, "label": labels.get(pid, ""), "kfc": kfc.get(pid), "score": round(float(sims[i]), 3)})
    return out

def whois(models: Any, atlas: Any, data: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    im = load_image(data)
    w, h = im.size
    faces = []
    for emb, score, (x1, y1, x2, y2) in detect(models.faces, im):
        faces.append({"box": [round(max(0.0, x1) / w, 4), round(max(0.0, y1) / h, 4),
                              round(min(float(w), x2) / w, 4), round(min(float(h), y2) / h, 4)],
                      "score": round(score, 3), "emb": _b64(emb),
                      "gallery": gallery_top(atlas, emb) if atlas else [],
                      "personas": persona_top(atlas, emb) if atlas else []})
    log.info("whois: %dx%d photo, %d face(s)", w, h, len(faces))
    return {"width": w, "height": h, "faces": faces}

def gallery_photo(gallery: Path, name: str, width: int = 320, index: int = 0) -> bytes | None:
    """An identity's ``index``-th photo (sorted, exemplar copies ``*_addedN`` left out), small,
    as JPEG (names are folder names: no paths)."""
    if not NAME_OK.match(name):
        return None
    folder = gallery / name
    if not folder.is_dir():
        return None
    photos = [p for p in sorted(folder.iterdir()) if p.suffix.lower() in PHOTO_EXT and "_added" not in p.stem]
    if not 0 <= index < len(photos):
        return None
    first = photos[index]
    im = ImageOps.exif_transpose(Image.open(first)).convert("RGB")
    im.thumbnail((width, width * 2))
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    im.save(buf, "JPEG", quality=82)
    return buf.getvalue()

def cpu_cap(percent: float) -> bool:
    """A hard ceiling on this process AND everything it starts (ingest's gallery writer and
    taggers, vw, ffmpeg, rclone): a Windows job object with a CPU rate hard cap. Children join
    the job by themselves. Operator, 7 Oct 2026: "make sure you can't pop 8 vision workers" —
    thread settings alone didn't hold (the tagger's libraries start their own threads: ~370 %
    with 2 torch threads)."""
    global _JOB
    if sys.platform != "win32" or percent <= 0 or _JOB is not None:
        return False
    import ctypes
    from ctypes import wintypes

    class CpuRate(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("ControlFlags", wintypes.DWORD), ("CpuRate", wintypes.DWORD)]

    # A private kernel32: the types declared below must not change ctypes.windll.kernel32 for the rest
    # of the process (they did: SetPriorityClass then overflowed and the worker died at start).
    k = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    # Declared, or ctypes passes the 64-bit handles as 32-bit ints ("invalid handle").
    k.CreateJobObjectW.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    k.CreateJobObjectW.argtypes = [wintypes.LPVOID, wintypes.LPCWSTR]
    k.GetCurrentProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
    k.SetInformationJobObject.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.c_int, wintypes.LPVOID, wintypes.DWORD]
    k.AssignProcessToJobObject.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, wintypes.HANDLE]
    job = k.CreateJobObjectW(None, None)
    info = CpuRate(0x1 | 0x4, int(min(100.0, percent) * 100))  # ENABLE | HARD_CAP; rate in 1/100 %
    if not job or not k.SetInformationJobObject(job, 15, ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.sizeof(info)) \
            or not k.AssignProcessToJobObject(job, k.GetCurrentProcess()):
        log.warning("cpu cap: not applied (error %d)", ctypes.get_last_error())
        return False
    _JOB = job
    log.info("cpu cap: this worker and its helpers together use at most %.0f %% of the CPU", percent)
// ... [truncated]

name: cap_threads
summary: insightface builds its onnxruntime sessions without options, i.e. on every core. Give every session created without options a small fixed budget, and run the whole process below normal priority so the operator's work wins.
code_excerpt:
def cap_threads() -> None:
    """insightface builds its onnxruntime sessions without options, i.e. on every
    core. Give every session created without options a small fixed budget, and
    run the whole process below normal priority so the operator's work wins."""
    import onnxruntime as ort
    base = ort.InferenceSession
    if getattr(base, "_panopticam_capped", False):
        return

    class Capped(base):  # type: ignore[misc, valid-type]
        _panopticam_capped = True

        def __init__(self, path, sess_options=None, providers=None, **kw):
            if sess_options is None:
                sess_options = ort.SessionOptions()
                sess_options.intra_op_num_threads = MODEL_THREADS
                sess_options.inter_op_num_threads = 1
            super().__init__(path, sess_options, providers=providers, **kw)

    ort.InferenceSession = Capped
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        import ctypes
        BELOW_NORMAL = 0x4000
        ctypes.windll.kernel32.SetPriorityClass(ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetCurrentProcess(), BELOW_NORMAL)

def __init__(self) -> None:
        cap_threads()
        if DEVICE == "cuda":
            cuda_dlls()
        import onnxruntime as ort

        providers = ["CUDAExecutionProvider", "CPUExecutionProvider"] if DEVICE == "cuda" else ["CPUExecutionProvider"]
        self.siglip = None
        self.faces = None
        if ROLE != "faces":
            self._siglip(ort, providers)
        if ROLE != "tower":
            from insightface.app import FaceAnalysis
            self.faces = FaceAnalysis(name="antelopev2", providers=providers,
                                      allowed_modules=["detection", "recognition"])
            # Thumbnails are ~360 px wide: detecting at 320 is 4x cheaper than 640 on CPU.
            self.faces.prepare(ctx_id=0 if DEVICE == "cuda" else -1,
                               det_size=(640, 640) if DEVICE == "cuda" else (320, 320))
        self.nudity = None
        if NUDENET and Path(NUDENET).exists():
            from nudity import NudeNet
            self.nudity = NudeNet(NUDENET, providers, threads=MODEL_THREADS)
        log.info("models ready (role %s; siglip %s, faces %s, nudenet %s)", ROLE,
                 "on" if self.siglip else "off", "on" if self.faces else "off", "on" if self.nudity else "off")

name: _siglip
code_excerpt:
def _siglip(self, ort, providers) -> None:
        path = MODEL_DIR / VISION_ONNX
        if not path.exists():
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            log.info("downloading %s", MODEL_BASE + VISION_ONNX)
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(MODEL_BASE + VISION_ONNX, str(path) + ".part")
            os.replace(str(path) + ".part", path)
        opts = ort.SessionOptions()
        opts.intra_op_num_threads = THREADS
        opts.inter_op_num_threads = 1
        self.siglip = ort.InferenceSession(str(path), opts, providers=providers)
        self.siglip_in = self.siglip.get_inputs()[0].name
        self.siglip_out = [o.name for o in self.siglip.get_outputs()].index("pooler_output")

signature_or_pseudo: def faces_in(self, im: Image.Image) -> list[tuple[np.ndarray, float, Image.Image]]
code_excerpt:
def faces_in(self, im: Image.Image) -> list[tuple[np.ndarray, float, Image.Image]]:
        """Every clear face in a frame: [(unit embedding, detection score, crop)]."""
        if self.faces is None:
            return []
        bgr = np.asarray(im)[:, :, ::-1].copy()
        out = []
        for f in self.faces.get(bgr):
            x1, y1, x2, y2 = f.bbox
            w, h = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
            if f.det_score < MIN_FACE_SCORE or min(w, h) < MIN_FACE_PX:
                continue
            # Generous crop (face plus hair and shoulders) for KFC's inbox.
            cx, cy, r = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, max(w, h)
            crop = im.crop((int(max(0, cx - r)), int(max(0, cy - r)), int(min(im.width, cx + r)),
                            int(min(im.height, cy + r))))
            out.append((f.normed_embedding.astype(np.float32), float(f.det_score), crop))
        return out

def face_of(self, im: Image.Image) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, Image.Image] | None:

def analyse(item: tuple[dict, Image.Image]) -> tuple[object, object]:
        w, im = item
        found = models.faces_in(im)
        # One face files the room's identity; several (a guest beside the host) are only
        # checked as guests (a couple's two faces averaged would match neither).
        face = found[0] if len(found) == 1 else None
        if len(found) > 1:
            face = [f[0] for f in found[:4]]
        nsfw = None
        if ROLE == "all" and models.nudity is not None and not w["key"].startswith("flirt4free:"):  # F4F: static photos
            try:
                nsfw = models.nudity.state(im, face is not None)
            except Exception as ex:
                log.debug("nudenet %s: %s", w["key"], ex)
        return face, nsfw

def stacks_on_demand() -> None:
        import faulthandler
        trigger = HOME / "dump-stacks"
        while True:
            time.sleep(10)
            if trigger.exists():
                with open(HOME / "stacks.log", "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                    fh.write(f"---- {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")

                trigger.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                log.info("stacks written to %s", HOME / "stacks.log")

code_excerpt:
def run_tower(models: Models) -> None:
    """The VPS side: frame states for every room that needs one, the room's look
    when it is due (hourly), and the clips. Fetches go to the backend next door."""
    clap = Path(ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_CLAP", str(HOME / "models" / "clap-htsat-unfused")))
    if ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_CLIPS", "1") == "1":
        from clipwork import ClipWorker
        sound = None
        if (clap / "onnx" / "audio_model.onnx").exists():
            from sound import Sound
            sound = Sound(clap, threads=MODEL_THREADS)
        # Threads and frames per short clip (30 Sep 2026: the VPS got the cores the QA runs
        # gave up; ONNX sessions are safe to run from several threads).
        frames = int(ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_CLIP_FRAMES", "2"))
        threads = int(ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_CLIP_THREADS", "1"))
        for _ in range(threads):
            ClipWorker(api, models.embed_images, sound, frames_embedded=frames).start()
        log.info("clips: analysing samples (sound %s, %d frames, %d threads)", "on" if sound else "off",
                 frames, threads)
        # Which language each room speaks and what it says (6 Oct 2026): Whisper beside CLAP, paced.
        # 9 Oct 2026: whisper-small int8 with the KV-cache decoder when it's there (~3.5 s a clip on the
        # VPS vs base's 1.5 s; kept a Russian line base scored -1.18 and dropped), else base.
        small = clap.parent / "whisper-small"
        whisper = Path(ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_WHISPER", str(small if small.is_dir() else clap.parent / "whisper-base")))
        q = "_int8" if (whisper / "onnx" / "encoder_model_int8.onnx").exists() else ""
        enc, dec = ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_WHISPER_ENCODER", q), ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_WHISPER_DECODER", q)
        if ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_SPEECH", "1") == "1" and (whisper / "onnx" / f"encoder_model{enc}.onnx").exists():
            from speech import Speech, SpeechWorker
            heard = Speech(whisper, threads=1, encoder=enc, decoder=dec)
            SpeechWorker(api, heard, every=float(ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_SPEECH_EVERY", "6"))).start()
            log.info("speech: listening with %s%s", heard.name, ", cached decoding" if heard.past else "")
    fetchers = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8)
    analysts = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=int(ENV.get("PANOPTICAM_ANALYSTS", "2")))

_only_instance
summary: Windows: a named mutex, so a second worker (an orphaned launcher loop, a manual start) exits at once instead of doubling the work and fighting over the recordings tunnel (1 Oct 2026: 24 launcher loops had piled up since 28 Sep). None = another worker runs.
code_excerpt:
def _only_instance() -> object | None:
    """Windows: a named mutex, so a second worker (an orphaned launcher loop, a manual start)
    exits at once instead of doubling the work and fighting over the recordings tunnel
    (1 Oct 2026: 24 launcher loops had piled up since 28 Sep). None = another worker runs."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return True
    import ctypes
    k32 = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    k32.CreateMutexW.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    handle = k32.CreateMutexW(None, False, r"Local\PanopticamVisionWorker")
    if not handle or ctypes.get_last_error() == 183:  # ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS
        return None
    return handle  # held (never closed) for the life of the process
